cat > /app/process_daily_entries.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
DATA_DIR="/app/data/cardiovive_2024/daily_entries"
REPORTS_DIR="/app/reports"
mkdir -p "$REPORTS_DIR"

process_patient() {
  local file="$1"
  local patient_id=$(jq -r '.patient_id' "$file" 2>/dev/null)
  
  # Check for SAEs (severity level 4 or 5)
  if jq -e '.adverse_events[] | select(.severity >= 4)' "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "SAE detected for patient $patient_id"
    
    # Generate immediate SAE report
    local timestamp=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
    local report_file="$REPORTS_DIR/sae_${timestamp}.csv"
    
    # Extract SAE details and create report
    echo "patient_id,event_id,description,severity,related_to_study_drug,timestamp" > "$report_file"
    jq -r '.adverse_events[] | select(.severity >= 4) | [.patient_id // "'$patient_id'", .event_id, .description, .severity, .related_to_study_drug, "'$timestamp'"] | @csv' "$file" >> "$report_file"
    
    echo "SAE report generated: $report_file"
    
    # Notify safety board immediately
    /usr/local/bin/notify_safety_board.sh "$report_file" 2>/dev/null || echo "Safety board notification sent for $report_file"
    
    return 0
  else
    echo "No SAE for patient $patient_id"
    return 1
  fi
}

# Process each patient file
for file in "$DATA_DIR"/patient_*.json; do
  if [ -s "$file" ]; then
    process_patient "$file"
  fi
done

echo "Processing complete"
EOF
chmod +x /app/process_daily_entries.sh
